faultSummary.OC: Over Current - Check motor load and cable integrity
faultSummary.OV: Over Voltage - Check input supply and deceleration time
faultSummary.UV1: Under Voltage - Verify power supply stability
faultSummary.OH: Over Heat - Improve ventilation, check ambient temperature
faultSummary.OL1: Motor Overload - Reduce load, check mechanical friction
faultSummary.OL2: Inverter Overload - Reduce load or increase capacity
faultSummary.GF: Ground Fault - Check motor winding isolation
faultSummary.CE-r: RS-485 Communication Error - Verify wiring, baud rate, and address
